programme.title: Aku Pilih Pelangi
programme.desc: Kesedihan Nayla bertukar menjadi kemarahan apabila Firdaus melampaui batas yang tidak mampu diperbetulkan lagi. programme.title: Aku Pilih Pelangi
programme.desc: Keputusan Nayla memberi kejutan besar kepada kedua-dua keluarga. programme.title: Aku Pilih Pelangi
programme.desc: Kehidupan selepas perceraian memaksa Firdaus dan Nayla memulakan lembaran baharu masing-masing. Ketika Iskandar masih berpegang pada harapan, masa depan seolah-olah sudah menuju ke satu arah, sehinggalah hati mula mempersoalkan apa yang disangka sudah berakhir.(n)

programme.desc: Pasangan pengantin baru, Gendis dan Joel, yang terpaksa dikuarantin di hotel selama tujuh hari selepas pulang berbulan madu. Hubungan mereka diuji apabila gangguan daripada bekas kekasih Joel mencetuskan rasa cemburu dan pertengkaran hebat akibat emosi Gendis yang sensitif.(n)

programme.title: Girls Only
programme.desc: Girls Only akan membawa penonton untuk berkenalan dengan Wani Ardy, bersenam bersama Kim di Phillip Wain, belajar menggayakan pakaian dan berborak denga Aunty HR mengenai isu pekerja.(n)

programme.title: Trendsetter
programme.desc: Trendsetter adalah rancangan mengenai trend fesyen dan gaya hidup. Kini kembali dalam musim terbaru bersama pengacara Zakuan Zainal. Episod kalini menampilkan 'TTroublemakers' dalam segmen Usha Kedai, Koleksi 'Gordon Soo' dan Bedah Kotak Placebo - Beru Bag.(n)

programme.title: Concert Dia.. Lagenda Unplugged Dato' Francissca Peter
programme.desc: Dalam rancangan ini, Dato' Francissca Peter berkongsi pelbagai cerita permulaan penglibatannya di dalam dunia seni nyanyian.(n)

programme.title: Analisa Anna Lisa
programme.desc: Anna Lisa, seorang suri rumah, menyiasat kematian misteri jirannya melalui podcast jenayah bersama dua wanita lain. Dalam mencari kebenaran, dia berdepan ugutan, pengkhianatan dan kehilangan, namun akhirnya menemui semula tujuan hidupnya.(n)

programme.title: Dear Hyeri
programme.desc: Dalam episod penutup, Eun ho memilih untuk bersama Hyun oh semula, walaupun ramai mengharapkan dia bersama Joo yeon. Hye ri “mengucapkan selamat tinggal”, memberi ruang untuk Eun ho menyembuhkan dirinya sepenuhnya.(n)

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Syarfan merupkan pengurus besar di sebuah syarikat automotif milik keluarganya. Akibat tergesa-gesa ingin menghadiri mesyuarat penting Syarfan tergelincir ketika melalui lantai yang basah. Accident itu telah menjadi satu titik pertemuan diantara Syarfan dan Antasya seorang gadis cantik yang bekerja sebagai seorang cleaner di syarikatnya.(n)

programme.title: Dulang Boy
programme.desc: Dulang Boy mengisahkan tentang seorang budak lelaki berusia 10 tahun bernama Kerol Lazania (KL) yang teruja kerana dipilih menjadi “dulang boy” untuk majlis perkahwinan kakaknya, Ros. Tugasnya adalah membawa dulang berisi sepasang kasut yang dianggap sangat Istimewa. Namun, pada pagi majlis perkahwinan, KL dan sahabat baiknya Yoyo mencuri masa untuk bergambar dengan kasut tersebut. Malangnya, KL terpijak lumpur lalu mengotorkan kasut tersebut. Mereka cuba mencuci kasut itu, tetapi akhirnya kasut tersebut koyak pula. KL dan Yoyo kemudian berusaha sedaya upaya untuk membetulkan keadaan sebelum majlis bermula.(n)

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Aisyah merindui kampung halaman, dia bersendirian di dalam kondo. Iskandar langsung tidak menghiraukan Aisyah dan terus membiarkan Aisyah bergerak sendiri di dalam kondo. Perbezaan alatan yang canggih di kondo itu membuatkan Aisyah sering melakukan kesilapan dan membuatkan dia dimarahi oleh Iskandar. Aisyah membiarkan dirinya terus dimarahi, kepergian dan kepulangan Iskandar ke kondo itu tidak langsung membuatkan mereka berhubung. Namun, disebabkan Aisyah seorang gadis kampung yang cerdik dan rajin, dia tidak pernah berhenti menyediakan makanan untuk Iskandar, segala keperluan memasak di pesan oleh Aisyah kepada Haziq yang sering datang ke kondo untuk menghilangkan rasa sunyi Aisyah meskipun Iskandar turut berada di kondo mewah itu. Hidup Aisyah yang bagaikan seorang isteri di dalam sebuah sangkar mewah dilenyapkan rasa sakit itu dengan aktiviti yang disukainya iaitu memasak. Disebabkan hidangan makanan yang lazat dan cukup membuka selera itu membuatkan mata Iskandar dan Aisyah kerap kali bertentang. Sementara satu pertemuan sedang di atur oleh Tengku Maria untuk meneruskan hasratnya menyatukan Iskandar dan Tengku Waiduri.(n)

Fatimah menghadiahkan sesuatu kepada Ustadz Jazlan dan menerima hadiah tasbih sebagai balasannya. Alawiyah dan Khatijah berjumpa dengan Habib untuk dapatkan doa-doa mustajab untuk melembutkan hati anak-anak mereka agar menerima cadangan untuk disatukan sebagai suami isteri.(n)

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Pertemuan yang dirancang dengan rapi antara Iskandar dan Tengku Waiduri membuatkan Iskandar semakin tertekan. Di pertemuan itu, Tengku Waiduri secara rahsia memberitahu Iskandar dia sudah mempunyai kekasih da meminta agar Iskandar menggagalkan rancangan Tengku Maria dalam apa jua keadaan, namun hal itu sukar dilakukan oleh Iskandar kerana jawatan CEO sedang menanti dirinya dan ditambah lagi dengan rahsia dia sudah mengahwini Aisyah. Entah kenapa malam itu, Iskandar rasa cukup tertekan, dia tidak tahu apa yang harus difikirkannya. Lalu Iskandar pergi berhibur bersama rakan-rakan dan pulang dalam keadaan mabuk. Aisyah memanjakan dirinya sendiri di kondo mewah itu setelah seharian melakukan kerja. Sebuah tab di ruangan bilik air menjadi pilihan Aisyah untuk memanjakan diri. Tidak sedar Iskandar sudah pulang dan keadaan Iskandar yang mabuk membawa kepada satu kejadian yang merentap mahkota Aisyah. Aisyah langsung tidak menyangka dirinya dirakus sebegitu oleh Iskandar namun dia redha kerana dia adalah seorang isteri, meskipun Aisyah sedar Iskandar tidak menyedari akan kelakuaannya ketika itu tetapi atas tanggungjawab seorang isteri dia harus membiarkan dirinya diperlakukan seperti itu. Aisyah lena di kamar Iskandar, di terkejut apabila Iskandar melemparkan wang di atas tubuhnya.(n)

programme.title: Isteri Dalam Sangkar
programme.desc: Pertemuan yang dirancang dengan rapi antara Iskandar dan Tengku Waiduri membuatkan Iskandar semakin tertekan. Di pertemuan itu, Tengku Waiduri secara rahsia memberitahu Iskandar dia sudah mempunyai kekasih da meminta agar Iskandar menggagalkan rancangan Tengku Maria dalam apa jua keadaan, namun hal itu sukar dilakukan oleh Iskandar kerana jawatan CEO sedang menanti dirinya dan ditambah lagi dengan rahsia dia sudah mengahwini Aisyah. Entah kenapa malam itu, Iskandar rasa cukup tertekan, dia tidak tahu apa yang harus difikirkannya. Lalu Iskandar pergi berhibur bersama rakan-rakan dan pulang dalam keadaan mabuk. Aisyah memanjakan dirinya sendiri di kondo mewah itu setelah seharian melakukan kerja. Sebuah tab di ruangan bilik air menjadi pilihan Aisyah untuk memanjakan diri. Tidak sedar Iskandar sudah pulang dan keadaan Iskandar yang mabuk membawa kepada satu kejadian yang merentap mahkota Aisyah. Aisyah langsung tidak menyangka dirinya dirakus sebegitu oleh Iskandar namun dia redha kerana dia adalah seorang isteri, meskipun Aisyah sedar Iskandar tidak menyedari akan kelakuaannya ketika itu tetapi atas tanggungjawab seorang isteri dia harus membiarkan dirinya diperlakukan seperti itu. Aisyah lena di kamar Iskandar, di terkejut apabila Iskandar melemparkan wang di atas tubuhnya.(n)

programme.title: Sedingin Cinta Antasya
programme.desc: Antasya memulakan tugas dengan mengemop lantai dengan perasaan geram akibat dimarahi oleh Vicha. Dia tertolak baldi yang berisi air sehingga tertumpah. programme.desc: Aisyah mengembalikan wang yang dilemparkan oleh Iskandar padanya dan menyedarkan Iskandar apa yang dilakukan pada malam itu hanya kerana statusnya sebagai isteri. Tersentak dengan itu, Iskandar terus meninggalkan Aisyah seharian. Di pejabat, Iskandar tidak dapat menumpukan sebarang kerja. Dia hanya memikirkan Aisyah dan apa yang telah berlaku antara mereka berdua. Sementara Tengku Maria sedang mengatur pertemuan kedua antara Iskandar dan Tengku Waiduri dan kali ini melibatkan keluarga mereka berdua. Tengku Waiduri memaksa pula Iskandar memulakan langkah untuk membatalkan hasrat Tengku Maria yang dilihat semakin ligat untuk menyatukan mereka. Kepulangan Iskandar ke kondo malam itu dirasakan sesuatu yang berbeza, meskipun dia masih tidak mempedulikan Aisyah tetapi dia menikmati hidangan yang disediakan oleh Aisyah untuknya dengan penuh nikmat. Tercuit rasa lapang di dadanya apabila itu adalah saat pertama dia makan semeja dengan Aisyah sejak mereka bergelar suami isteri selama 4 bulan.(n)

programme.title: Black S1 EP2
programme.desc: Pegawai penguatkuasa undang-undang Bunian 444 atau juga dikenali sebagai Black sedang diburu kerana rakan setugasnya seorang penderhaka, 419, telah melarikan diri ke dunia manusia. Menyedari 419 telah menghuni tubuh manusia, Black memutuskan untuk memasuki tubuh Malik untuk bersaing dengannya. Pada mata manusia, 'Malik' telah terselamat daripada kematian dengan menakjubkan sekali dan akibat kejadian itu dia telah hilang ingatan. Dalam pada itu, Sofia mula menyedari yang 'Malik' merupakan buat hatinya semasa kecil dan dia diselubungi rasa bersalah kerana telah meletak Malik dalam situasi bahaya. Namun 'Malik' sekarang ialah Black - biadab, mementingkan diri sendiri dan tekad dengan satu tujuan dalam misinya. Adakah dia akan ingat siapa Sofia sebenarnya? Black mendapati dirinya berdepan dengan pembunuhan yang mengerikan semasa dia cuba mengharungi dunia manusia. Keadaan menjadi lebih rumit apabila seorang lelaki yang penuh misteri muncul dan membayangi setiap gerak-gerinya.

programme.title: Black S1 EP3
programme.desc: Black mula seronok berada dalam badan manusianya. Namun menghuni tubuh badan manusia ialah jenayah Kelas A dalam dunia Bunian - Black menerima kata dua - dia mesti dapat mencari 419 atau menerima hukuman yang paling menggerunkan. Meskipun begitu, satu lagi kes pembunuhan yang mengerikan telah berlaku, sama seperti kejadian baru-baru ini. Nampaknya mangsa seperti ada kaitan dengan Aisya. Lelaki dengan wajah berparut muncul untuk menyeksanya ... siapa dia dan kenapa Aisya mengikut arahannya? Sofia dapat tahu yang mungkin ayahnya telah dibunuh dan ini membawanya kepada CEO Insurans Mahkota, Lokman Nazir, yang boleh mendapatkan fail lama ayahnya ... dan mungkin menjadi petunjuk kepada identiti pembunuh ayahnya.

programme.title: Interchange
programme.desc: Dihantui oleh penglihatan yang suram, jurugambar forensik Adam berundur dari dunia, tinggal di rumah dan mengambil gambar jirannya sehingga dia diseret ke dalam penyiasatan lain oleh kawan baiknya, Detektif Man, yang meminta bantuannya untuk menyelesaikan siri pembunuhan ritual yang mengerikan. Pada masa yang sama, hobi Adam yang kelihatan tidak berbahaya tidak lama kemudian menjadi lebih gelap apabila dia mengintip Iva, seorang wanita muda dari Borneo. Terpesona olehnya, dia tidak lama lagi terjerat dalam rangkaian misteri dan pembunuhannya. Ketika Adam diseret lebih jauh ke dalam dunia puak Iva dan Man menyelidiki penyiasatannya dengan lebih mendalam, mereka menemui mistik bawah tanah bomoh dan makhluk ghaib di bandar itu.

programme.title: J Retribusi
programme.desc: Jay, bekas ketua Unit Tindakan Khas (UTK), kini menjadi pengawal keselamatan kepada Nadi, anak Dato' Hashim. Ketika Dato' Hashim terperangkap dalam rancangan penjenayah, Jay, bersama Chang dan Amy, berjuang menyelamatkan Nadi dari menjadi tebusan. Dengan keberanian, strategi, dan semangat keluarga, mereka menentang musuh yang licik, menghadapi cabaran demi cabaran demi memastikan keselamatan Nadi dan menebus masa lalu Jay.

programme.desc: Alam mimpi telah menjadi tempat percutian Nabila dan Amry. Semasa mereka berkongsi harapan dan ketakutan antara satu sama lain, mereka belajar tentang masalah yang harus mereka selesaikan dalam kehidupan masing-masing di dunia nyata.

programme.desc: Mak Timah dan Cikgu Zaiton masih tidak berpuas hati dengan Cikgu Siti yang dikatakan memiliki ilmu hitam. Farhan masih cuba berbaik-baik dengan Cikgu Siti, bagaimanapun Cikgu Siti cuba menjauhkan diri dari Farhan kerana telah diberi amaran oleh Mak Timah.

Selain itu, McCall mula risau apabila anak perempuannya, Delilah, berhenti bergaul dengan seorang rakan karibnya, manakala pencarian Detektif Dante terhadap McCall mengambil satu arah yang tidak dijangka.

programme.desc: Mengisahkan seorang lelaki yang membela hantu raya yang di warisi oleh ayahnya dengan terpaksa. Namun lama kelamaan dia mula suka dengan saka belaan tersebut. Setelah bertahun-tahun dan usianya yang menghampiri kematian, pak Harun mula sedar dan cuba membuang hantu raya tersebut yang mula menganggu penduduk kampung. Apatah lagi anak gadisnya putus tunang akibat dia membela hantu raya tersebut. Pak Harun akhirnya berjaya membuang hantu raya tersebut dengan bantuan seorang ustaz. Pak harun akhirnya meninggal dunia, anak dan isterinya berpindah selepas kematian pak harun.(n)

programme.title: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu
programme.desc: Sebuah rumah di tengah dusun tak dapat di robohkan sehingga di beli oleh faizal dan Yana. Faizal dan yana telah kehilangan anak perempuan mereka akibat kemalangan. Di dusun Yana bertemu Rinah iblis yang mendiami rumah tersebut. Rinah bagitahu Yana kalau dia boleh kembalikan anak yana yang mati. Yana lakukan ritual dan Naily benar-benar kembali. Faizal yang mulanya tak percaya pada hantu dan iblis akhirnya akur kalau rumah yang mereka beli itu benar-benar berpenunggu. Menurut cerita rumah itu kepunyaan Rinah seorang bidan yang banyak membantu gugurkan kandungan dan suaminya Hamdi seorang bomoh. Keduanya mati di dalam rumah di bunuh penduduk kampung.(n)

programme.title: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu EP3
programme.desc: Sebuah rumah di tengah dusun tak dapat di robohkan sehingga di beli oleh faizal dan Yana. Faizal dan yana telah kehilangan anak perempuan mereka akibat kemalangan. Di dusun Yana bertemu Rinah iblis yang mendiami rumah tersebut. Rinah bagitahu Yana kalau dia boleh kembalikan anak yana yang mati. Yana lakukan ritual dan Naily benar-benar kembali. Faizal yang mulanya tak percaya pada hantu dan iblis akhirnya akur kalau rumah yang mereka beli itu benar-benar berpenunggu. Menurut cerita rumah itu kepunyaan Rinah seorang bidan yang banyak membantu gugurkan kandungan dan suaminya Hamdi seorang bomoh. Keduanya mati di dalam rumah di bunuh penduduk kampung.(n)

programme.title: Nak Dengar Cerita Hantu EP4
programme.desc: Mengisahkan rachel yang di bunuh dengan kejam oleh david dan kawan-kawannya. Roh Rachel yang tak tenteram kembali mebalas dendam pada setiap pembunuhnya. Selepas sepuluh tahun Rachel berjaya melepaskan semua dendamnya dengan kematian David.(n)

Selain itu, pelajaran memandu Delilah membawa McCall dan Aunt Vi untuk mengajarnya satu pelajaran yang lebih besar tentang tanggungjawab peribadi.(n)

programme.title: Highland Tower
programme.desc: Pada Disember 1993, sebuah blok kondominium mewah runtuh selepas hakisan tanah dari lereng bukit bersebelahan. Kira-kira 50 orang terkorban dan kejadian ini sehingga kini menjadi salah satu tragedi paling gelap dan menyedihkan dalam sejarah Malaysia. Dua puluh tahun kemudian, pada 2013, sekumpulan pembuat filem dokumentari menjelajah ke dua blok yang masih berdiri untuk menjalankan ekspedisi memburu hantu. Apa yang mereka temui tidak sesuai untuk mereka yang lemah semangat.(n)

programme.title: Unhuman
programme.desc: Semasa keluar berkhemah, San dan rakan-rakannya dari sekolah menengah merakam gambar meteor yang terhempas. Gambar itu mengandungi petunjuk kematian seorang saintis yang menjalankan kerja eksperimen dengan organ manusia dan kemungkinan kaitan dengan ahli sihir Kemboja.(n)

programme.title: Larian Terakhir
programme.desc: Haziq, seorang anak tunggal kepada Mariam yang mempunyai bakat dalam larian pantas, sering berhadapan dengan dugaan kehidupan sehinggakan dia terpaksa meninggalkan ibunya yang sakit. Tanpa disedarinya, pertemuannya dengan Jalal telah memerangkapnya dalam sebuah sindiket jenayah. Walaupun Haziq dijanjikan peluang untuk memperbaiki hidupnya, Amelia sentiasa mengawasi setiap pergerakannya dengan teliti. Larian Terakhir adalah sebuah filem yang menggabungkan genre aksi dan sukan dengan penampilan pelakon-pelakon seperti Fattah Amin, Amyra Rosli, dan Fahrin Ahmad, di mana setiap larian akan sampai ke kemuncaknya.(n)

programme.title: J Revolusi
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Jay Zulkarnain (Haji Zul Ariffin), ketua Unit Tindakan Khas (UTK) yang digeruni penjenayah. Konflik tercetus apabila kakaknya, Dian (Nur Fazura), ditangkap pengganas misteri, Andra (Farid Kamil), yang memiliki Ultra Virus berbahaya. Jay ditugaskan menyekat ancaman virus itu sambil menyelamatkan kakaknya yang dijadikan tebusan. Namun, misi itu membawa tragedi apabila pasukannya terkorban, menimbulkan pelbagai tuduhan dan kejutan. Bersama rakan setugas, Eddie (Izara Aishah) dan Jiman (Iedil Putra), Jay berjuang menentang masa dan musuh untuk menyelamatkan Dian dan menggagalkan rancangan Andra.(n)

programme.title: Budak Pendamping
programme.desc: Ia mengisahkan tentang seorang budak yang berumur 16 tahun, bernama Firash. Dibesarkan sebagai seorang anak tunggal di sebuah keluarga yang sentiasa sibuk dengan kerjaya, membuatkan Firash lebih senang bersendiriaan. Disebabkan itu keluarganya membuat keputusan untuk hantarnya ke sebuah kem. Disana Firash bertembung dengan Idlan dan rakannya Khai dan Sahar, serta sebahagian dalam Ahli Majlis Tertinggi Asrama (AMTA) bagi kem tersebut. Akibat ketidakpuasan mereka terhadap Firash yang kelihatan lembik, badannya menjadi tempat untuk mereka lepaskan kekerasan. Namun kehadiran budak pendamping mengubah segalanya untuk Firash tetapi ia juga menggugat kesejahteraan yang dah lama tidak bergelora. Lantas, adakah perjanjian antara Firash dan pendampingnya merupakan ilusi semata - mata ataupun terdapat hutang yang akan dituntut antaranya dengan Tuan Daud?(n)

programme.title: The Equalizer S1
programme.desc: Panggilan dari luar negara untuk mendapatkan bantuan daripada anak perempuan mentor CIA McCall yang telah meninggal dunia memaksa McCall, Mel dan Harry bekerja dari jauh untuk membantu wartawan konflik itu ketika dia dikejar oleh skuad hit di Perancis. Selain itu, Mak Cik Vi menjadi curiga apabila McCall ponteng keluar pada malam keluarga lain untuk bekerja.(n)

Anaknya merupakan peninju Muay Thai dan atas desakan yang bertubi-tubi, bapa akhirnya mewariskan ilmu yang dikenali sebagai 'Jurus Siku 12 Langkah Derhaka' kepada anaknya yang akan bertanding pada pertandingan terbuka Pendang Muay Thai 2021.(n)

programme.title: Aku Ada Kau Ada ???
programme.desc: Seorang pelajar bernama Nordin Ahmad yang ingin kelihatan “cool” di mata orang lain. Walau bagaimanapun, setiap kali Nordin menjadi tumpuan, dia akan menjadi panik dan muntah. Sementara itu, Aziz pula seorang pelajar yang perasan popular yang selalu menyakat Nordin. Tina pula seorang pelajar yang baru bertukar ke kolej mereka untuk menjalani sebuah program khas untuk mengatasi sikap panas baran yang ditawarkan oleh Dr. Zida.

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

programme.title: Usop Wilcha Mehghonjang Makhluk Muzium
programme.desc: Mengisahkan sebuah muzium yang ingin mengadakan satu pameran “Hantu-Hantu Dunia” untuk menarik minat pengunjung. Tanpa disedari, penganjuran pameran ini mempunyai matlamat tersendiri. Melalui perancangan licik sekumpulan pengamal ilmu hitam dari Romania, pameran ini sebenarnya ingin menghidupkan kembali Raja Dracula. Mengikut kepercayaan kumpulan ini, Raja Dracula akan dapat hidup kembali dengan mendapatkan darah manusia dari setiap benua.

programme.desc: Pegawai Daerah, Azam Wasli berusaha untuk membangunkan Laka, sebuah kawasan terpencil di Sarawak. Pelbagai rintangan dihadapinya yang ingin menyatukan puak di kawasan itu. Azam turut menemui cinta bersama Mei Ling, seorang wartawan - tetapi dia diambil sebagai tebusan untuk menggugat posisi Azam. Insiden itu membawa kepada perjumpaan semula antara dua saudara.

programme.title: Leftenan Adnan
programme.desc: Adnan memutuskan untuk menjadi seorang tentera dalam pasukan Askar Melayu setelah dikunjungi anggota tentera British yang datang ke kampungnya untuk merekrut lebih ramai anak tempatan. Tidak direstui keluarga, Adnan nekad untuk mengikuti latihan ketenteraan di Port Dickson. Perjuangan Leftenan Adnan dalam mempertahankan Tanah Melayu memberikan inspirasi kepada ramai anak muda tempatan.

programme.title: Jiran
programme.desc: Mengisahkan Ramlan sekeluarga yang baru berpindah di sebuah kawasan perumahan. Namun, Ramlan melarang isteri dan anaknya Tina daripada bergaul dengan jiran-jiran mereka di situ. Ramlan sendiri beranggapan bahawa dengan berlaku sombong terhadap orang, dirinya akan dipandang mulia. Kesombongan Ramlan itu akhirnya menyusahkan dirinya sendiri apabila berlaku satu insiden yang melibatkan kehilangan Tina.

programme.title: Tuah
programme.desc: Datuk Shaari dan Shahira diselamatkan oleh seorang lelaki yang mendakwa bahawa dirinya Hang Tuah, seorang pahlawan Melayu di abad ke-15. Meragui kisahnya, mereka membawanya melakukan pemeriksaan fizikal dan mental di hospital, lama-kelamaan Shahira mula mempercayainya. Tuah secara ajaibnya telah dibawa ke zaman moden dan mula mempelajari apa yang terjadi pada masa lalu. Akhirnya, Tuah pulang semula ke tempat asalnya dan mula membetulkan keadaan.

programme.title: Darah Satria
programme.desc: Berpangkat Leftenan Muda, Ariff terlibat dalam operasi memburu komunis di hutan. Mempunyai seorang isteri bernama Rafidah, namun terpaksa ditinggalkannya bersama ibu bapanya kerana sibuk menjalankan operasi. Dalam satu operasi menentang komunis, Ariff bersama anak buahnya melalui kesukaran yang menyebabkan Ariff mengalami kecederaan manakala salah seorang daripada mereka terkorban.

programme.title: Estet
programme.desc: Mengisahkan para pekerja estet Cinta Manis yang bakal bertarung dengan kumpulan estet Red Cobra dalam satu perlawanan bola sepak yang sudah 20 tahun tidak diadakan. Farid dan Shashi, dua pekerja estet yang berkawan sejak kecil, menjadi harapan pekerja estet yang lain untuk menyelamatkan penindasan yang dilakukan oleh kerani estet, Pooniah. Seorang gadis cantik bernama Geetha tertarik hati dengan Farid dan Shashi. Sesi latihan dikendalikan oleh Subramaniam iaitu bapa Geetha yang dilantik sebagai jurulatih. Ayah kepada Shashi, Apaa, adalah pemain bola yang sangat mahir, tetapi telah berlaku insiden semasa perlawanan bola sepak estet itu dahulu yang mana kakinya patah diterjah oleh Junna, seorang samseng estet yang sengaja ingin menamatkan karier Apaa atas upahan Pooniah 20 tahun yang lalu. Berjayakah Farid dan Shashi serta kawan-kawannya membebaskan pekerja estet Cinta Manis daripada penindasan Pooniah?

programme.title: Pecah
programme.desc: Empat orang lelaki berjaya merompak sebuah bank tetapi malangnya salah seorang daripada mereka cedera dan terpaksa dirawat di hospital. Pada masa yang sama, seorang wanita yang menjaga orang tua di sebuah rumah orang tua, membawa salah seorang penghuninya ke hospital yang sama untuk mendapatkan rawatan. Apa yang berlaku kemudiannya ialah pembongkaran demi pembongkaran agenda tersembunyi, di samping penyiasatan daripada pihak polis pada masa yang sama.(n)

programme.desc: Mengisahkan pasangan suami isteri, Tania dan Tyo, yang terlalu sibuk dengan kerjaya sehingga hubungan mereka semakin renggang. programme.title: Jin Notti
programme.desc: Jin Notti, seekor jin nakal dari dunia jin, dihantar ke bumi untuk belajar menjadi baik dengan membantu manusia. Namun, misinya jadi huru-hara apabila dia jatuh cinta dengan gadis manusia bernama Amy, lalu mencetuskan pelbagai situasi lucu dan romantik antara dua dunia.

programme.title: The Voice of Hind Rajab
programme.desc: Mengisahkan kejadian sebenar tentang Hind Rajab, seorang kanak-kanak perempuan berusia 6 tahun yang terperangkap di dalam sebuah kereta di Gaza dan membuat panggilan kecemasan untuk mendapatkan bantuan. programme.title: Diari Abah
programme.desc: Rahmat dipulaukan oleh tiga anaknya, Annur, Zarif & Zakuan, setelah berkahwin buat kali kedua dengan Ashikin, ibu tunggal anak satu. Anak-anaknya menganggap kematian ibu mereka, Khalijad berpunca daripada keputusan Rahmat berkahwin lain. Tercatat dalam diari itu bahawa segala duit yang dikirimkan setiap bulan digunakan abah mereka untuk mendirikan rumah anak yatim atas permintaan arwah ibu mereka dengan nama Rumah Anak Yatim Cik Khalijah.(n)

programme.title: Me VS Mami

programme.title: Grow Grow Grow With You
programme.desc: From "Hopscotch" to "Hands Up," TVB's children's programs have accompanied children's growth, creating countless wonderful childhood memories. Veteran children's program hosts Tam Yuk-ying, Lai Chi-shan, and Gai Sai-bo have also grown up alongside you! Each episode will feature a different theme, inviting hosts from different eras to reunite and reminisce about the past. Decades have passed, and the young hosts and participants of yesteryear have all grown up considerably. The hosts have gone out of their way to find these people and relive those memorable moments with everyone. The classic segment "Soaring Through the Air" holds countless happy memories. The hosts and guest Ali Lee will guide a new generation of children through the fun.

programme.title: Dolce Vita 2022
programme.desc: Hong Kong life is vibrant and diverse, and "Hong Kong Life, Hong Kong Enjoyment" presents both sophisticated and elegant lifestyles and down-to-earth, high-quality experiences. The program combines diverse themes, exploring different areas in each episode and inviting elites from various industries to share their secrets to success.

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.

programme.title: Ratman To The Rescue
programme.desc: Gossip magazine journalist Tong Leung-sing (Sammy) has unfortunately lost his left ear in a traffic accident. He gains mystical rat power after undergoing transplant surgery. Leung-sing keeps creating fake news just to benefit himself. He clashes with righteous policewoman Sung Hoi-yan (Priscilla Wong), causing both of them to lose their jobs. With the support of her uncle Ming Kwan-ngai (KK Cheung), Hoi-yan becomes a private investigator. Leung-sing is forced to help Hoi-yan with her investigation activities as Hoi-yan catches him using his mystical power to peep at goddess Ming Cheuk-kei (Zoie Tam). Gold digger Tong Mei-fun (Kamen Kong) is cruelly harassed as rich clan heir Tsui Tsun-wai (Daniel Chau) and she become foes. Mei-fun forgives Tsun-wai and offers to help him as Tsun-wai gets into a difficult situation. Leung-sing becomes increasingly arrogant as he uses to his mystical power to solve cases. Meanwhile, Hoi-yan shockingly finds out Kwan-ngai's real character. Leung-sing faces the danger of exhausting his mystical power and becoming a rat as he helps Hoi-yan.

Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors.".

programme.title: Want To De-stress

Celebrities will also be invited to have candid conversations with the host, sharing their effective methods for coping with the heavy pressures of life and work. The program also includes many interesting stress-reduction tips to deepen viewers' understanding of the importance of stress reduction for health.

programme.title: Try It? Really? (Sr.2)

Stephanie Che continues to host, offering her warm smile to the contestants; Maria Cordero, Chow Kwok-fung, Cheung Ka-tim, Hai-er, and Gu Ya-wei also serve as judges, providing professional feedback and encouragement to the participants. On this new season's stage, everyone will weave an even more moving chapter with music, continuing the heartfelt story of " Midlife, Sing & Shine! 4.".

programme.title: A Date with Goddess (Sr.2)
programme.desc: The core premise revolves around TVB's eligible single female artists (dubbed the "Goddesses") who participate in an unscripted journey to find real romance. Single male contestants from all walks of life—recruited through a worldwide open casting call—compete through speed dates, interactive challenges, and romantic one-on-one dates to win their hearts.

programme.title: Dear Leslie 70
programme.desc: Dear Leslie 70 is a TVB Jade memorial music special honoring the 70th birth anniversary of Hong Kong legend Leslie Cheung. The show celebrates his legacy across Cantopop, TV, and cinema by showcasing iconic archival performances, classic hits like "Monica" and "Chase," and tribute covers by fellow artists. It also features personal stories and memories shared by close friends, including Leo Ku performing the tribute song "Dear Leslie.".

programme.title: Star Weekly
programme.desc: The talk show "Star Weekly" invites celebrities and industry leaders each episode, along with entertainment anchors such as Au Wing-Kuen, Hsu Wen-Hsuan, and Wang Chen-Chuan, to share their recent work plans and discuss special topics related to movies, television, and concerts, especially people and events that netizens and friends in the industry are concerned about and discussing! programme.title: Gourmet Express Weekly
programme.desc: Hong Kong is a melting pot of global cuisine! programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show (Sr.5)
programme.desc: Li Jiading (Master Ding), the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up "Master Ding's Kitchen," partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!

programme.title: Chill. Hike. Camping
programme.desc: With travel restricted due to the pandemic, many people have opted to connect with nature and discover the joys of local outings and camping. Four former Miss Hong Kong contestants—Ho Wing-sau, Liu Wai-yee, Wu Mei-yee, and Chan Yeuk-sze—set aside their formalities and escaped the hustle and bustle of city life, joining various "outdoor experts" on adventures. They explored mountains and seas, experiencing outdoor activities like picnics, mountain art photography, car parking, diving, kitesurfing, and even taking on challenges like mountain art tests, boating to collect trash on deserted beaches, and rappelling on a deserted island. These diverse outdoor activities included experiencing a flash flood and witnessing the power of nature! Will they ultimately become Hong Kong "wild women" with exceptional physical strength, willpower, and environmental awareness?

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure trove—if we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program "News Treasure Hunt" guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.(n)

programme.title: Vital Lifeline
programme.desc: Urban dwellers often experience a hectic pace of life and high levels of stress, making them more susceptible to health problems. "The Strongest Lifeline" helps you unravel the secrets to good health. To start, the program features a four-episode series on common urban pain issues, covering headaches, shoulder and neck pain, back pain, and joint pain. Each episode invites medical experts to explain the causes of these conditions, as well as physical therapists and exercise specialists to teach appropriate exercises. With the growing trend of integrating Eastern and Western medicine, even American swimming champion Michael Phelps uses cupping therapy to relieve pain. Therefore, each episode also includes traditional Chinese medical diagnosis, complemented by treatments such as acupuncture, cupping, and the “Sanfu” herbal patch therapy, which is especially suitable during the hottest days of summer. In addition, Chinese medicine practitioners share recipes for nourishing soups, all of which can help regulate and improve your health.(n)

programme.title: Return of the Cuckoo
programme.desc: Twenty years previously, CHU SHA KIU (SIT KA YIN, NANCY) met an undergraduate from Hong Kong, CHUK CHIN FAI (KWOK FUNG) and they immediately fell in love with each other. However soon afterwards, FAI decided to further his study in the United States. KIU, though had just found herself pregnant, agreed reluctantly to let him go just for the sake of his future. Since then, KIU has lived with her own daughter, CHUK KWAN HO (SHEH CHARMAINE) and her adopted child, MAN CHOR (CHEUNG CHI LAM, JULIAN). Having been abandoned by her lover, CHOR's mother flied into a fury of grief and gave CHOR, who was then an infant, a corrosive substance to drink. CHOR was fortunately rescued by KIU in time but his vocal cords had become paralysed because of the serious damage. CHOR regards HO as his sister and does not realise his extraordinary passion for her until SZETO LAI SHUN (MA CHUN WAI, STEVEN) appears. HO is an affectionate girl and is always full of tender solicitude towards all. She is thus torn by the confusing emotions of love for the three men around her, CHOR, SHUN and KAM SING (TONG MICHAEL). CHOR's voice begins to recover after the vocal operation conducted by a renowned surgeon. As he feels that he is unable to bring HO any physical well-being, he withdraws and has decided to leave for Hong Kong to look for his own mother. Meanwhile, by thinking of HO's future, KIU urges HO to depart from Macau and to live with FAI. Who will win HO's heart eventually? Will KIU be left alone by HO and CHOR?(n)

programme.title: Like Mother, Like Daughter
programme.desc: Public relations queen TONG MAN-LEI (Jinny Ng) raises her Gen Z daughter TONG SUM ( Desta Lee) alone and she is a control freak. MAN-LEI's mother, TONG CHO KA-BING (Stephanie Che), has spent half of her life supporting her husband and raising their children. She is suddenly "awakened" and she returns to Hong Kong from Canada. She decides to reclaim her lost time and she moves into MAN-LEI's home. Many years ago, KA-BING and her daughter completely fell out because MAN-LEI insisted to have her daughter out of wedlock. Now, KA-BING suddenly breaks in without warning and disrupts MAN-LEI's life. MAN-LEI strives to maintain order, while TONG SUM mediates between the two, creating sparks and constant conflicts in this three-generation household. In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.(n)

programme.title: Hands Up 2026
programme.desc: The brand-new children's program “Hands Up” encourages kids to ask questions bravely, express themselves, and pursue their goals! Members of the mascot “Sauce Family” join the hosts in performing short skits, accompanying everyone for joyful moments. The show will also feature a variety of children's songs, allowing kids to sing along while learning practical life knowledge.(n)

programme.title: Her Railway Trip & What's On Today
programme.desc: Japan's railway world is incredibly diverse, stretching from winding valleys to coastal lines. Every train window is like a flowing landscape painting, captivating railway enthusiasts. In recent years, it has also attracted many women, giving rise to the unique nickname "Tetsuko" (meaning "railway girl"). The program, led by up-and-coming actresses Ni Jiawen and He Yongshao, takes viewers on a journey through the charm of Japanese railway travel. It not only introduces the railways themselves but also explores the prefectures and cities traversed by the railways, showcasing the unique landscape created by the intertwining of railways and towns. Whether you're a railway enthusiast or a viewer who enjoys exploring new cultures, "Tetsuko's Lofty Mountain" offers a romantic and surprising railway journey.(n)

programme.title: Cause Of Death
programme.desc: Newly appointed female forensic pathologist Dr. Ching Chi-yan (Hera Chan) has always been inspired by Dr. Lam Sum (Willie Wai). And ever since Chi-yan was a kid, she has aspired to join the Forensic Pathology Service. However, she is sidelined by her boss Dr. Lam Sum after starting her new job. Lam Sum and his ex-wife Ko Shuk-han (Alice Wong), RCU Senior Inspector, cannot stand each other. Their paths cross again as their daughter Lam Suet-lui runs away from home. Chi-yan gains Lam Sum's approval with her industrious work attitude and forms a bond with police officer Ko Chun (Mark Ma). The three of them gradually become a well-coordinated crime-busting trio. After experiencing heartbreak and unemployment, Chi-yan's buddy Sin Pui-ka (Jinny Ng) becomes a local news reporter. She and seasoned reporter Tsim Pak-yu (Nicholas Yuen) evolve from playful rivals to supportive partners. Just as Chi-yan's career is progressing well, she hears the news of her good friend Pui-ka's death. She is determined to uncover the truth and speak out for the deceased!(n)

programme.title: The Truth Within & What's On Today
programme.desc: Qi Sizhe becomes Director of Forensic Medicine for the Hecheng Criminal Police Unit, reunites with Han Feng, and investigates the truth behind his girlfriend Yu Fei's death from the drug Original Diamond three years earlier. A series of nightclub attacks, cocoon murders, medical-school specimen crimes, insurance frauds, and silencing killings all point to a new narcotic and a drug-manufacturing ring. Police raid the drug factory, arrest Wu and the traffickers, and close the new Original Diamond case.(n)

programme.title: Gourmet Express
programme.desc: Hong Kong brings together global cuisines, and its unique dishes and down-to-earth fare have captured the close attention of discerning food lovers! Food hosts and presenters such as Icy Wong,Snowy Choi,Carmen Ngai,Carmaney Wong , Jessica Liu , Gillian Ng keep up with the latest food news and deals, delving into the stories behind the flavors. Gathering firsthand information on popular eateries across various platforms, the hosts personally line up and taste the food, providing genuine reviews. Even takeout-only eateries with no dine-in option are in high demand—what are the must-try picks? Running a food business inevitably comes with its own mix of sweet, sour, bitter, and spicy experiences. The production team follows the proprietors through their busy day, from sourcing ingredients and preparing materials to opening for business, uncovering the "stories behind the flavors.".(n)

programme.title: I Go To Taiwan On Foot
programme.desc: The best way to understand the local customs and culture is through in-depth travel, exploring every corner of the city on foot, appreciating the scenery along the way, discovering the local life and culture, and embracing unexpected surprises and challenges. Shih Chao-ri and Tsai Ching-hsing were lured to Taiwan by a production team to film a reality show. Starting from Kaohsiung Airport, they conquered over 300 kilometers, traveling from Tainan to Taipei. Visiting eight cities in eight days, with only NT$1,000 per day, the two racked their brains to solve problems like transportation and food, while also completing various assigned tasks, even exchanging labor for accommodation; with limited resources, they had to "use any means necessary" to achieve their goals….(n)

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning (Bai Lu) went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-ning's wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Wei's (Zhang Linghe) pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin (Zhou Junwei) from getting involved in the “coming-of-age” incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei's strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels' scheme. She and Zhang Zhe (Wang Xingyue) venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi (Liu Xening) does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.(n)

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?(n)

programme.title: News Treasury 2026
programme.desc: As the saying goes, "Today's news is tomorrow's history." With so much news every day, it's hard for everyone to take it all in, let alone look back at history. History is a treasure trove—if we ignore or underestimate it, we might miss out on its riches. The new program "News Treasure Hunt" guides viewers to uncover news gems from this vault. In addition to special features, live broadcasts, and series reports from the past, the show offers never-before-seen precious footage. Audiences will have the chance to revisit events such as Bruce Lee's funeral, the Bank of Po Sang robbery, the Gang of Four trial, the Queen's visit to Hong Kong, taxi strikes, the signing of the Sino-British Joint Declaration, an exclusive interview with Margaret Thatcher, Vietnamese refugees, the death of Governor Youde, Chris Patten's arrival in Hong Kong, the closure of Kai Tak Airport, the passing of Deng Xiaoping, the 1997 Handover Ceremony, the China Airlines Hong Kong crash, and SARS press conferences.(n)

programme.title: Return of the Cuckoo
programme.desc: Twenty years previously, CHU SHA KIU (SIT KA YIN, NANCY) met an undergraduate from Hong Kong, CHUK CHIN FAI (KWOK FUNG) and they immediately fell in love with each other. However soon afterwards, FAI decided to further his study in the United States. KIU, though had just found herself pregnant, agreed reluctantly to let him go just for the sake of his future. Since then, KIU has lived with her own daughter, CHUK KWAN HO (SHEH CHARMAINE) and her adopted child, MAN CHOR (CHEUNG CHI LAM, JULIAN). Having been abandoned by her lover, CHOR's mother flied into a fury of grief and gave CHOR, who was then an infant, a corrosive substance to drink. CHOR was fortunately rescued by KIU in time but his vocal cords had become paralysed because of the serious damage. CHOR regards HO as his sister and does not realise his extraordinary passion for her until SZETO LAI SHUN (MA CHUN WAI, STEVEN) appears. HO is an affectionate girl and is always full of tender solicitude towards all. She is thus torn by the confusing emotions of love for the three men around her, CHOR, SHUN and KAM SING (TONG MICHAEL). CHOR's voice begins to recover after the vocal operation conducted by a renowned surgeon. As he feels that he is unable to bring HO any physical well-being, he withdraws and has decided to leave for Hong Kong to look for his own mother. Meanwhile, by thinking of HO's future, KIU urges HO to depart from Macau and to live with FAI. Who will win HO's heart eventually? Will KIU be left alone by HO and CHOR?(n)

programme.title: I Go To Taiwan On Foot
programme.desc: The best way to understand the local customs and culture is through in-depth travel, exploring every corner of the city on foot, appreciating the scenery along the way, discovering the local life and culture, and embracing unexpected surprises and challenges. Shih Chao-ri and Tsai Ching-hsing were lured to Taiwan by a production team to film a reality show. Starting from Kaohsiung Airport, they conquered over 300 kilometers, traveling from Tainan to Taipei. Visiting eight cities in eight days, with only NT$1,000 per day, the two racked their brains to solve problems like transportation and food, while also completing various assigned tasks, even exchanging labor for accommodation; with limited resources, they had to "use any means necessary" to achieve their goals….(n)

programme.title: Want To De-stress
programme.desc: Many urban dwellers are constantly striving for a living and a career, leaving no time for relaxation. The accumulated stress can quickly trigger health problems. This program invites professionals from various fields, such as aromatherapists, music therapists, color therapists, nutritionists, and psychologists, to use accessible methods, including case studies and fun quizzes, to bring out the harmony and balance of the five senses, helping viewers instantly release stress. Celebrities will also be invited to have candid conversations with the host, sharing their effective methods for coping with the heavy pressures of life and work. The program also includes many interesting stress-reduction tips to deepen viewers' understanding of the importance of stress reduction for health.(n)

programme.title: The Ahistoric Grandpa Cooking Show (Sr.5)
programme.desc: Li Jiading (Master Ding), the tough guy, is undoubtedly a master of martial arts, but it turns out his culinary skills are equally impressive! Master Ding has set up "Master Ding's Kitchen," partnering with the discerning food connoisseur Tan Yuying. Each episode takes viewers on a sourcing trip for their favorite ingredients, and Master Ding personally cooks a variety of his signature dishes, soups, and desserts, offering a taste of nostalgic Cantonese cuisine! How to cook authentic traditional salt-baked chicken at an affordable price? How to control the heat and time when steaming fish? In autumn and winter, many people love fragrant claypot rice, especially the crispy rice crust. But have you ever seen claypot rice with crispy rice on both sides? Watch Master Ding show off his skills and teach you how!(n)

In the workplace, the wealthy heir, “Marketing Guru” YEUNG FAN (Gary Chiu), is parachuted into the company to lock horns with MAN-LEI on equal footing. MAN-LEI's career and family are facing crises at the same time.(n)

programme.title: Scoop 2026
programme.desc: "Scoop" airs from Monday to Sunday, closely following major social events and interesting stories, while also reporting the latest updates in the entertainment industry, celebrity news, as well as drama promotions and behind-the-scenes features. The "Today's Breaking News" segment keeps viewers up to date with the day's hottest stories. The in-depth feature section explores current affairs, social, and livelihood issues that the public cares about, interviewing relevant experts for their insights.(n)

programme.title: Cho Lam & His Trip Buddies
programme.desc: After his "One-Stroke-Wear" journey to Dongguan and Shantou, Wong Cho-lam continues his series' authentic style with another travel program. This time, however, he'll be joined by friends, and the main theme will be a series of in-depth revisites along the milestones in Cho-lam's life, uncovering the fun and warmth of everyday life. The filming locations span Fuzhou, Guangxi, and Vancouver—three distinctive places that have held significant meaning for Cho-lam at different stages of his life. Cho-lam walks through the streets and alleys with three groups of "travel friends," exploring everything from hometown connections and cultural awakening to the most important aspect—his romantic destiny—telling his unique story through travel snippets.(n)

programme.title: Story of Kunning Palace
programme.desc: Jiang Xue-ning (Bai Lu) went to great lengths to become the Empress. But she was forced to take her own life in the palace. Fast forward to the present, and Jiang Xue-ning's wish is to stay away from power struggles and control her destiny. However, she still somehow enters the palace as a study partner and becomes Master Xie Wei's (Zhang Linghe) pupil. While learning from Xie Wei, Jiang Xue-ning plots to prevent Yan Lin (Zhou Junwei) from getting involved in the “coming-of-age” incident. By following Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei's strategy, the Yans manage to stay alive. After the coming-of-age crisis, Jiang Xue-ning unwittingly gets embroiled in the imperial court crackdown on Lord Pingnan rebels' scheme. She and Zhang Zhe (Wang Xingyue) venture into enemy territory. At the critical moment, Jiang Xue-ning uses her body to shield arrows for Zhang Zhe. But the duo eventually cannot stay together. Hostile the State of Yue launches an invasion. First Princess Shen Zhi-yi (Liu Xening) does not hesitate to go down the road to making peace by marriage. To save her buddy Shen Zhi-yi, Jiang Xue-ning goes with Xie Wei to the north to deal with the State of Yue. While overcoming difficulties, Xie Wei does not mind getting hurt as he protects Jiang Xue-ning. The duo gradually have affectionate feelings for each other. However, an even more evil conspiracy gradually surfaces, and it astonishingly points to the truth about the Lord Pingnan incident from twenty years ago. Jiang Xue-ning and Xie Wei eventually team up to uncover the truth from yesteryear. Jiang Xue-ning also uses love to influence Xie Wei. The couple eventually find happiness.(n)

programme.title: Big City Shop 2026
programme.desc: “Big City Shop” introduces viewers to a wide range of timely topics, including seasonal products, health and wellness, fitness activities, skincare and makeup, fashion apparel, infant care, parenting knowledge, local delicacies, and pet care trends. The content is all-encompassing! In addition to hands-on demonstrations, experiences, or tests by the hosts, experts are invited to share their professional insights. In the cooking segment, several skilled culinary experts take turns showcasing simple and delicious healthy dishes and home-style recipes, helping everyone solve their cooking challenges.(n)

programme.title: Happy Old Buddies
programme.desc: Many people may think that older adults do not have sexual needs, but surveys have shown that this is not the case—older adults often experience less sexual activity due to various reasons. Clinical psychologist Lin Haoming from the Social Welfare Department explains the World Health Organization's definition of sexuality and offers advice for those hoping to rekindle their sex life with their partner. However, if one partner does not wish to resume sexual activity, how should both sides communicate?(n)

programme.title: Want To De-stress
programme.desc: Many urban dwellers are constantly striving for a living and a career, leaving no time for relaxation. The accumulated stress can quickly trigger health problems. This program invites professionals from various fields, such as aromatherapists, music therapists, color therapists, nutritionists, and psychologists, to use accessible methods, including case studies and fun quizzes, to bring out the harmony and balance of the five senses, helping viewers instantly release stress. Celebrities will also be invited to have candid conversations with the host, sharing their effective methods for coping with the heavy pressures of life and work. The program also includes many interesting stress-reduction tips to deepen viewers' understanding of the importance of stress reduction for health.(n)
